verdict.rationale: n8n workflows run autonomously via triggers (webhooks, schedules, MCP triggers), self-hosted or cloud, with error-handling workflows for failure recovery and persistent execution logs, and community users confirm running it unattended in production for months processing millions of workflows. missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence specifically validating long-running/background reliability at scale beyond anecdotal HN comments, and more detail on scheduling/queue-mode architecture for autonomous execution.
